about_the_game:
Monsters and Magics is a casual online card game meant to be played with friends. New and familiar mechanics inspired by classic card games combine to create a unique experience.

Game Features

  • Play online with friends through Steam or LAN

  • Battle against 10 computer controlled opponents with different play styles

  • Over 300 unique cards

  • Monster Summoning mechanic lets you play powerful cards from your deck and hand

  • Action point system used to keep turns shorter and decision making important

  • Start every game with your chosen Field card enabling synergies and combos while guiding deck building

  • Unlock all cards in game by playing

  • Earn in game money to buy any card
